newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Bainbridge Island SD #303, Wash..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Bainbridge Island SD #303, Wash..

text.p: Unlimited Tax General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997A

Sealed bids will be received by Bainbridge Island School District No. 303, Kitsap County, Washington, at the offices of Preston Gates & Ellis LLP, Columbia Center, 701 Fifth Avenue, Suite 5000, Seattle, Washington, until 9:00 a.m., Pacific standard time, on
(or other date or time as may be established by the District and communicated through Bloomberg and Munifacts News

Service not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received) at which time and place such bids will be publicly opened and read. The bids will be acted on by the District at its special meeting on the day bids are received.

The Bonds will be dated April 1, 1997; will be fully registered in book-entry only form registered initially in the name of Cede & Co., as bondowner and nominee for DTC. The Bonds will mature on December 1 in the years 1998, 2000, 2002, 2004 through 2008, inclusive and 2010 through 2016, inclusive. Purchases of the Bonds must be made in

denominations of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof within a single maturity. The Bonds must be purchased at no less than 99.5 percent of the aggregate principal amount. Interest rates bid must be in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of one percent.

The approving legal opinion of Preston Gates & Ellis LLP, attorneys, Seattle, Washington, will be furnished, without cost, to the purchaser of the Bonds. Further information, including a preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained, upon request, from Seattle-Northwest Securities Corporation, Seattle, Washington, the District's financial advisor, (206) 628-2882.
